post.summary:
Proxies credentials to the central auth-server. The panel never stores
passwords; a central rejection maps onto a uniform 401 without details.

401.description: Rejected by central auth or not configured

get.summary:
Identity snapshot for the SPA. Browser sessions may mutate; personal tokens
need `admin-panel:write`. Legacy role bindings stay disabled in central mode.

200.description: Independent observations, stale flags and safe aggregates

409.description: Resource reserved or original readback required

get.summary:
Public, cacheable service catalog for fleet consumers (switcher UIs).
Only active services with an approved declaration are exposed.

409.description: not active or capability not declared
